Released: 7 August 2026

Bug fixes, and security fixes in Postgres Enterprise Manager 10.5.1 include the following:

## Security Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-17566, an OS command injection vulnerability in Import/Export Data.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed CVE-2026-17566, an OS command injection vulnerability in Import/Export Data. <code>_is_query_parens_balanced()</code> incorrectly treated <code>\'</code> as an escaped quote under <code>standard_conforming_strings=on</code> (the PostgreSQL default), allowing a crafted payload to expose a live <code>TO PROGRAM</code> clause for remote code execution via <code>\copy</code>. The lexer was updated to match psql's actual behavior.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-17346, a SQL injection vulnerability in the Index Statistics and Pub/Sub views.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed CVE-2026-17346, a SQL injection vulnerability in the Index
Statistics and Pub/Sub views. The fix for CVE-2026-12044 missed sinks
allowlisted on the incorrect assumption that schema, table, publication,
and subscription names from the browser tree cannot contain apostrophes.
All remaining unescaped <code>'&#123;&#123; name }}'</code> interpolations were converted to
use <code>qtLiteral</code>.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-17351, a read-only guard lexer bypass in the AI Assistant.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed CVE-2026-17351, a lexer bypass in the AI Assistant's read-only guard. A payload exploiting the difference between <code>sqlparse</code> and PostgreSQL string-literal lexing under <code>standard_conforming_strings=on</code> could smuggle DML statements past <code>_validate_readonly_query</code> while PostgreSQL executed them.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-17347, an OS command injection vulnerability in <code>MASTER_PASSWORD_HOOK</code>.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed CVE-2026-17347, an OS command injection vulnerability in <code>MASTER_PASSWORD_HOOK</code>. The hook substituted the username for <code>%u</code> and executed with <code>shell=True</code>; a username containing shell metacharacters (possible with OAuth/OIDC or Kerberos authentication) allowed arbitrary command execution. The untrusted value is now passed as a separate argument, never concatenated into the shell string.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-17350, a tool-permission bypass on backend routes and Socket.IO handlers.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed CVE-2026-17350, a tool-permission bypass on backend routes and Socket.IO handlers. Tool permissions were previously enforced only on each tool's &quot;front door&quot; route, while the rest of the backend relied on <code>@pga_login_required</code> alone. Checks are now applied consistently across all routes and handlers for Query Tool, Grant Wizard, Schema Diff, ERD, PSQL, Debugger, Backup/Restore, Import/Export, and Search Objects.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed CVE-2026-17348, a missing <code>@pga_login_required</code> decorator on several routes.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed CVE-2026-17348, a missing <code>@pga_login_required</code> decorator on several routes, an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-12046. The decorator was added to the Constraints nodes, proplist, and delete routes, <code>preferences.get_all_cli</code>, <code>debugger.close</code>, and <code>schema_diff.close</code>.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>


## Bug Fixes

<table class="table w-100"><thead><tr><th>Description</th><th width="10%">Addresses</th></tr></thead><tbody>
<tr><td><details><summary>Added a watchdog thread subsystem to the PEM agent to resolve a class of
bug where the agent would become unresponsive.
</summary><hr/><p>Added a watchdog thread subsystem to the PEM agent. This thread monitors
the other agent threads and can intervene if they become blocked or
unresponsive.</p>
</details></td><td>45933</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby PEM could keep sending duplicate notifications if
the PEM server itself became resource-exhausted.
</summary><hr/><p>Added a two-phase commit protocol to all four notification spoolers
(SMTP, SNMP, webhook, and Nagios) to eliminate duplicate alert sends when
the PEM database becomes resource-exhausted between the send and its
terminal-status commit.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed an issue whereby report templates designated for PEM servers only
could be run on non-PEM servers, or on a different database, leading to
errors and confusion.
</summary><hr/><p>When a PEM report template is selected in the <strong>Run Report</strong> menu or a
scheduled job step, the PEM server and database fields are now
auto-selected and locked automatically. PEM reports are hidden entirely on
non-PEM servers.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a bug whereby the PEM backend database could become overloaded by
purge operations, with long-running table locks leading to false-positives
&quot;server/agent down&quot; alerts.
</summary><hr/><p>The purge system now deletes data in smaller batches, and the purge
process is now throttled to avoid overloading the PEM backend database.
This resolves a class of bugs where long-running table locks during purge
operations could lead to false-positive &quot;server/agent down&quot; alerts.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a new PEM agent failing to register against a PEM server running 10.1.0.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed a backward-compatibility regression whereby a new PEM agent failed
to register against a PEM server running 10.1.0. Also fixed SSL key and
certificate paths being stored as relative rather than absolute paths
during agent registration (PEM-6174).</p>
</details></td><td>62259</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a missing <code>post_connection_sql</code> value on <code>server_options</code> insert.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed an issue whereby <code>post_connection_sql</code> was missing on <code>server_options</code> insert, which could leave server connection options in an inconsistent state after registration.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a <code>qtLiteral requires a connection</code> error when opening a job step's <strong>Properties</strong> panel.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed a <code>qtLiteral requires a connection</code> error when opening the <strong>Properties</strong> panel for a job step. <code>JobStepView.list</code> and <code>.properties</code> rendered <code>properties.sql</code> without passing <code>conn=</code> to <code>render_template</code>, causing a <code>ValueError</code> after the <code>qtLiteral</code> hardening.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a dashboard freeze caused by an unhandled re-render loop.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed a dashboard freeze caused by an unhandled re-render loop under
certain widget configurations. Also fixed the <strong>Permissions</strong> panel content
being obscured by an overlapping scroll area.</p>
</details></td><td>60038</td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed alert row expansion collapsing or jumping to the wrong row on refresh.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed an issue whereby alert row expansion would collapse or jump to the
wrong row on data refresh. Row expansion is now bound to row identity
rather than display position.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed the expanded PgTable detail panel showing the wrong table after a sort or filter.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed an issue whereby the expanded PgTable detail panel showed the wrong
table's details after a sort or filter. The detail panel is now bound to
row identity rather than display position.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a <code>NullType</code> crash during Flask-Security's <code>fs_uniquifier</code> reflection on SQLite-backed upgrades.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed a <code>NullType</code> crash during Flask-Security's <code>fs_uniquifier</code> reflection
on SQLite-backed PEM upgrades.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td><details><summary>Fixed a <code>qtLiteral requires a connection</code> error when opening a job schedule's <strong>Properties</strong> panel.</summary><hr/><p>Fixed a <code>qtLiteral requires a connection</code> error when opening the <strong>Properties</strong> panel for a job schedule. <code>JobScheduleView.list</code> and <code>.properties</code> rendered <code>properties.sql</code> without passing <code>conn=</code> to <code>render_template</code>, causing a <code>ValueError</code> after the <code>qtLiteral</code> hardening.</p>
</details></td><td></td></tr>
</tbody></table>
